data.one_liner: Adds customizable scroll shadows to scrollable Flutter children.
data.what_it_does: ScrollShadow is a single-purpose widget that automatically displays fade-in/fade-out shadows at the edges of a scrollable child (such as a ListView) when the content is scrollable in that direction and not at its maximum extents. It supports both vertical and horizontal orientations and customizable animation durations, curves, sizes, and colors.
use_when: You want to indicate to users that a list or scrollable view has more content to scroll through.
You need a clean shadow effect on a scrollable container without manually managing a ScrollController.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based scroll indicators or scroll bars instead of gradient shadows.
Targeting platforms where edge fading shadows conflict with design guidelines.
strengths: Supports vertical and horizontal scrolling axes.
Works with or without an explicit ScrollController.
Allows nesting multiple ScrollShadow widgets without interference.
weaknesses: Limited to applying gradient shadows at scroll extents.
Does not replace a scrollbar or thumb indicator.
